title: Bound stock review context without losing pinned evidence or the original closed acceptance list
acceptance: Why: Captain authorized completing all existing PR repairs and standard acceptance before external-repository work, until 2026-10-02 08:00 Asia/Taipei. T-130 stock Codex review failed twice on 2026-10-01 because actual input was 2719034 characters versus maximum 1048576. This narrowly scoped repair removes that acceptance blocker; it does not claim the broader T-135 worker evidence-pack feature complete. Commit this task spec.

Bound assembled review context below a documented conservative vendor input limit, with explicit truncation/provenance and paths for omitted detail. Preserve exact pinned head/base/patch, original first complete numbered closed list, subsequent item dispositions and newly introduced regression context. Never silently discard acceptance items or reinterpret REJECT as APPROVE.

Run mode may replace an oversized inline diff with pinned-checkout file/path/range references and clear instructions to inspect the actual diff locally. Diff-only mode must fail truthfully or use a supported bounded representation with coverage disclosure; do not pass a truncated patch as complete. Bound repeated historical review comments and large CI logs while retaining the original complete standing criteria. Firstmate briefs remain evidence, not worker reasoning.

Fail-first meaningful regression using the real oversized T-130 shape and stale/repeated lists: stock composed prompt remains within cap, original numbered acceptance is preserved, trimming is visible, pin binding remains consistent, and a truly unrepresentable context fails before wasting model calls. Reviewers do not run suites; standard CI and gates provide evidence.

Do not change sandbox/trust policy, vendor/model selection, verdict provenance, or production code unrelated to context assembly. Record bootstrap dependency on the candidate T-163 launcher if used for real acceptance; no fake CI verdicts or direct vendor launches.
